summary: JSONARGS modules contain <<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_JSON_ARGS>>, replaced with the JSON argument string; the language must handle the quoting (e.g. Python triple quotes), otherwise use a want JSON or old-style module.
questions: How can a script module get its arguments as JSON embedded in the code?
What placeholder does Ansible replace with module arguments?
What if my language can't safely quote embedded JSON?

answer_card.title: JSONARGS modules
answer_card.answer_md:
Include `<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_JSON_ARGS>>` in the script:
```python
json_arguments = """<<INCLUDE_ANSIBLE_MODULE_JSON_ARGS>>"""
```
Ansible substitutes the JSON args (double quotes escaped, single quotes unescaped). Your language must quote that safely; if not, write a want JSON or old-style module.
